newsitem.title: USA: Tech-Sym sees lower Q3 profits.
newsitem.headline: Tech-Sym sees lower Q3 profits.

text.p: Tech-Sym Corp said on Monday that it expects third quarter net income to range from $3.2 million to $3.4 million, or about $0.51 to $0.55 per share.
Tech-Sym's third quarter profits last year totaled $3.9 million, or $0.60 a share.
Revenues are expected to reach $86 million in this year's third quarter, Tech-Sym said.
Tech-Sym said its lower than expected earnings were primarily a result of continued slower than anticipated sales of geoscience software products.

Tech-Sym said employee reductions and consolidation of software development centers undertaken at the CongniSeis unit in the third quarter, plus additional employee reductions to be completed in the fourth quarter, will enhance future results.
